messages.text: Hi, welcome to Northstar Energy. How can I help you today?
My electricity meter casing is cracked and it will not switch on. This is urgent.

Account reference: NS-000123

Urgency: high
Please confirm these details or tell me what to change.
What does a standing charge on my energy bill cover?

A standing charge is a fixed daily amount that helps cover the cost of supplying electricity or gas to your property. It is charged for each day your account is connected, even when you use little or no energy. This explanation is illustrative and is not a tariff or a quote.
